integrity: Each phase once; evaluate once; report regardless of outcome.
interpretation: Historical replay with current metadata; new identities but same venue/time era. Not live, not news, not profit.
objective: Transfer of the unchanged May7-9 row_hgb7 quote-change booster to never-used contracts on the unopened week June 8-14.
primary: Matched row-weighted log loss row_hgb7 vs activity_logit. PASS = lower LL than activity_logit and global_rate, no higher Brier, AND contract-clustered 95% bootstrap lower bound of gain vs activity_logit > 0.
reporting_floor: <100 known, <20 positives or <20 negatives, or <5 contributing contracts = insufficient.
secondary: Brier, AP, AUC, equal-contract LL, per-date/per-contract wins, strict, nonoverlap, date-clustered bootstrap, missing-label bounds.
selection: Identity/event-type/clock columns only from 2026-06-07T12,T13 (consumed block); market IDs in [0x10,0x18) (disjoint from all earlier cohorts, all <0x0a); >=2 book events in both hours; not in 1231 protected IDs or earlier 60; SHA256(salt+id) order; Gamma metadata: binary Yes/No, 2 tokens, description, event IDs not in earlier cohorts, one contract per event, start<June8 and end>June15; first 40. No price/quote/outcome column before freeze. Shortfall is reported, not replaced.
target: Midpoint differs after 30 minutes by >1e-12; same 18 features and gates as the June1-7 test.
